achievements.name: Clincher
achievements.desc: 100 enemies shot in the head. Not bad for a head start…

achievements.name: Goodnight
achievements.desc: Get 20 covert kills. The Zone likes it quiet.

achievements.name: On the go
achievements.desc: Bread and sausage — Zone's most popular sandwich recipe.

achievements.name: Tit for tat
achievements.desc: Sidorovich's worst nightmare: buy and sell goods for the exact same amount of coupons in one deal.

achievements.name: First touches
achievements.desc: First equipment enhancement. Never the last, for most Zone folks.

achievements.name: The good, the bad and the ugly
achievements.desc: 5 headshots in 10 seconds. Good eye.

achievements.name: Bingo
achievements.desc: Experience the effects of bleeding, sleep, hunger, alcohol, radiation and psi. Doesn't sound pretty.

achievements.name: Zone's deadliest predator
achievements.desc: Kill a mutant of every kind. You'll need a bigger wall to fit all those trophies!

achievements.name: Pump it up
achievements.desc: Fully enhance any type of weapon. Somewhere out there, a Zone technician just shed a tear of pride..

achievements.name: The four winds
achievements.desc: Unlock the whole map. Few folks know the Zone this well.

achievements.name: Taking it for granted
achievements.desc: Gear broken beyond repair. Don't forget to pay regular visits to the technician.

achievements.name: Miracle hoarder
achievements.desc: Collect all artifacts. What about arch-artifacts?

achievements.name: Curiouser and curiouser!
achievements.desc: Collect all arch-artifacts. A priceless collection, arguably too weird, even by Zone standards.

achievements.name: No obstacle too big…
achievements.desc: Kill 50 enemies through obstacles. No one in the Zone is really safe.

achievements.name: BOOM!
achievements.desc: 20 enemies killed by blowing up the surroundings. Save on hand grenades and enjoy the fireworks.

achievements.name: Personal approach
achievements.desc: One fight, four enemies, killed by different weapons. That trick would charm the hell out of Mavka!

achievements.name: Loner shooter
achievements.desc: Shoot an enemy in the head from 75 meters. No scope-peeking!

achievements.name: Merry-go-round
achievements.desc: Drop a corpse into the Whirlgig anomaly. A joy for someone who never got to ride the Ferris Wheel.

achievements.name: Keeping your hands steady
achievements.desc: Shoot an enemy in the head, through an obstacle, having the intoxication effect.

achievements.name: Catching up
achievements.desc: Shoot an incoming grenade to make it explode. Nice view!

achievements.name: Flash Royal
achievements.desc: Gather all armor and gear enhancement flash drives.

achievements.name: Wiped out
achievements.desc: Kill a Rodent using a grenade launcher. A good wipe-out makes the Duty proud.

achievements.name: Can opener
achievements.desc: Use a knife to kill an enemy wearing an exoskeleton. Epic battle indeed.

achievements.name: Coupons to burn
achievements.desc: Spend over 1,000,000 coupons. Myklukha and Sidorovich will fight hard over their favorite customer.

achievements.name: Bouncy
achievements.desc: A successful jump from a 30-meter height. No parachute, though.

achievements.name: Run, stalker, run!
achievements.desc: That Chimera made you run like an Olympic champion!

achievements.name: Peace and quiet
achievements.desc: Kill everyone in the camp before the alarm is set off. They couldn't see it coming!

achievements.name: Proxy
achievements.desc: Kill a squad that just finished off another squad and won the fight. Or so they thought…

achievements.name: Lockpick
achievements.desc: Lure a mutant into an anomaly. Hardly a noble deed, but it gets the job done.

achievements.name: Welcome to the Zone
achievements.desc: Prologue complete, but this is so far from over.

achievements.name: Good hunting, stalker
achievements.desc: Leave the Lesser Zone to go Scanner-hunting. More miracles await, and more dangers, too.

achievements.name: Would you like some toast?
achievements.desc: Meet Scar.

achievements.name: Eyes on the prize
achievements.desc: Retrieve the stolen Scanner. Time to find out what is so special about it.

achievements.name: House of glass
achievements.desc: Witness the temple of science get destroyed.

achievements.name: Such is the will of the Monolith
achievements.desc: Kill Faust.

achievements.name: I see you have many questions
achievements.desc: Meet the C-Consciousness Representative. Didn't Strelok finish them off?

achievements.name: Doctor's oath
achievements.desc: The mysterious Doctor had to reveal what he'd been hiding.

achievements.name: Living legend
achievements.desc: Meet Strelok. How was it, talking to a living legend?

achievements.name: The Prypiat guardian
achievements.desc: Meet Degtyarev in Prypiat. The toughest place in the Zone has the toughest-looking watchman.

achievements.name: Brave new world
achievements.desc: Korshunov sacrificed himself so that humanity could have a new future, free of doubt and the Zone.

achievements.name: Today never ends
achievements.desc: Scar went into the pod to rid the Zone of darkness.

achievements.name: She will never be free
achievements.desc: Strelok went into the pod to protect her. Always.

achievements.name: Project Y
achievements.desc: Go through with Kaimanov's initial plan.

achievements.name: Wardens drool
achievements.desc: Save a bandit's life, get on the Ward's naughty list. Was it worth it?

achievements.name: Stalker's smarts
achievements.desc: Find a way to get the parts without sneaking into the warehouse.

achievements.name: The good ol' days
achievements.desc: Help Skadovsk get its name and rightful owners back.

achievements.name: Apple-shot
achievements.desc: Three precise shots at apples spared stalker lives and helped you win a twisted bandit's game.

achievements.name: Baptism by fire
achievements.desc: Help Zalissya survive the Monolith attack. New generations of stalkers will have a place to stay.

achievements.name: On a leash
achievements.desc: The Leash project experiments are finally over. Hopefully.

achievements.name: Your move!
achievements.desc: Found a unique weapon designed for a kingpin. Checkmate!

achievements.name: Goss
achievements.desc: Join Stalkers for some campfire gossip.

achievements.name: Legends never die
achievements.desc: Kill the Strelok.

achievements.name: All quiet in the Zone
achievements.desc: Kill Korshunov.

achievements.name: Alas poor Yorick
achievements.desc: Kill Scar.

achievements.name: One awkward step
achievements.desc: I am blind, but it's you who cannot see.

achievements.name: Monolith envoy
achievements.desc: You know more than I do, envoy.

achievements.name: Between the lines
achievements.desc: The "Best reader" award. And reward.

achievements.name: Scanning complete
achievements.desc: You were out looking for a scanner, but ended up collecting them all.

achievements.name: High voltage
achievements.desc: Find a way into the Iron Forest. What mysteries are waiting behind the wall?

achievements.name: Casus Belli
achievements.desc: Witness the breach of D4. Myklukha and Voronin wouldn't budge, so Duty and Freedom are foes again.

achievements.name: The territory of the future
achievements.desc: Get to the SIRCAA ruins and see for yourself what's left of the 'Temple of Science'.

achievements.name: Welcome back
achievements.desc: Get out of the Spatial Bubble. That place was weird, even by Zone standards.

achievements.name: Shadows of the idols
achievements.desc: Meet the founders of Duty and Freedom. Their beliefs may be different, but determination is common.

achievements.name: Freedom of Choice
achievements.desc: Take Mavka's side in the conflict with Zulu.

achievements.name: This is our Duty
achievements.desc: Take Zulu's side in the conflict with Mavka.

achievements.name: It's a no-brainer!
achievements.desc: Defeat the Psi Brain. Bigger isn't always better.

achievements.name: The end of the Golden Era
achievements.desc: Kill Myklukha in the Arena. This performance will be hard to beat.

achievements.name: His last order
achievements.desc: Witness Voronin's sacrifice at the Monorail. Now you have to make sure it was worth it.

achievements.name: Kilometer Zero
achievements.desc: Reach the CNPP and join the ranks of the Zone's legends.

achievements.name: In the heart of the enemy
achievements.desc: Set up a new Duty base at the CNPP. The Zone will one day end where it began.

achievements.name: The times of Freedom
achievements.desc: Set up a new Freedom base at the CNPP. Will there be an Arena, too?

achievements.name: Battle on – and win your battle!
achievements.desc: Help Zulu destroy all the samples of the technology. One less threat in the Zone.

achievements.name: Contra spem spero
achievements.desc: Help Mavka save the technology and bring it to the Mainland. And get an Oasis as a farewell gift.

achievements.name: The draw of the Flare
achievements.desc: Put together fragments of the past and grasp the light of the Flare.

achievements.name: Get your hands dirty
achievements.desc: Get an artifact from the chimera's remains in the Spatial Bubble with your own hands.

achievements.name: Voices of the Zone
achievements.desc: Get a hint for a stash from the Faraday Anomaly. The Zone favors those who listen.
